newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pac launches office leasing plan.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pac launches office leasing plan.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd is launching an office leasing programme on Thursday on its DCH Commercial Centre at eastern Hong Kong, said CITIC's executive director Patrick Chung.

The 28-storey single office tower, which has a total office area of about 388,000 square foot, would be leased out at a monthly rental of between HK$30 and HK$35 per sq ft, Chung told a news conference.
"If all the office spaces of DCH Commercial Centre are rented out, it will generate a rental income of about HK$150 million per year," he said.
The grade A office developed from the Dah Chong Hong motor serices centre at Quarry Bay is scheduled to be completed in mid-February 1998.
CITIC has appointed CITIC Pacific Property Agents Ltd, C.Y. Leung & Co Ltd, and Marlin Land Ltd as joint leasing agents for the development.
Chung also said the government has approved CITIC Pacific's plan to transform its industrial building in Kowloon's Taikoktsui into an office tower.
"We will soon start refurbish the building and turn it into an office tower," he said. CITIC Pacific planned to hold the building for investment purpose, he added.
